name: Puppy Large
labelNotes: Feed twice daily and provide plenty of fresh, clean water.
Use the chart as a guide: monitor weight and adjust portions as needed.
Pregnant dogs: increase by 25% to 50% of the adult amount. Nursing dogs: feed free choice.
Made for puppies of large breeds (adult weight about 32 kg or more).

source.notes: Feeding table, cup size (8 fl oz cup = 120 g), transition food and size statement: feeding guide image supplied by the owner (no energy figure on it). Energy: ORIJEN Australia product page (AAFCO version), 'Metabolizable energy is 3760 kcal/kg (451 kcal per 8oz. cup)', stored as 376.0 kcal/100 g; the same 3760 kcal/kg appears on the AU FEDIAF page and both US pages. The owner's table matches the maker's AU (and identical US) AAFCO feeding calculator except 60 kg adult / 30 kg puppy: maker 485 g, owner's guide 480 g (kept, owner's bag wins). The maker's FEDIAF pages show a different table (e.g. 320, 630, 840 g). The label's 30 kg column is headed 'medium-large breeds'; 40-50 kg 'large', 60-80 kg 'giant'. food:report flags the 5 kg row (40-80 kg columns) and the 10 kg row (80 kg column) at 51-54% of the NRC estimate: that is what the label and the maker print (160 g for every 5 kg puppy), not a transcription error. Phosphorus: AU AAFCO page, '(min.) 1%'.
